main_text.l: [Syriac/Hebrew word] Syr. Adverb. Plus, magis, potius, potissimū,
vehementer, vehementius, multò magis.
[Syriac word] Syr. Abundantia, Luc. 12.15. Excellentia,
præcellentia, præstantia, ad Rom. 3.1.
[Hebrew word], [Hebrew word] Ch. & Syr. Utilitas, commodum, e-
molumentum, lucrum. Plur. [Syriac word] Tit. 1.7.
[Hebrew word] Ch. Chordæ, restes, nervi, Judic. 16.7.8.9. [Hebrew
word], [Hebrew word] Ch. Residuum, redundans, reliquū:
Præstantia, emolumentum, Exo. 16.13. Eccles. 2.13.
[Syriac word] Chald. Præstans, excellens. Plural. [Syriac word]
[Syriac word] Præstantiores estis, præstatis, Matth. 6.
[Syriac word] Syr. Residua, redundantia, superflua, Mar. 8. 8.
Constr. [Syriac word] Ex abundantibus, ex iis quæ
abundant, Matth. 12.34. Lucæ 6.45. Hinc Tartaro-
rum seu Totarorū appellatio orta, de quo vide Vi-
rum Illustrem Philipp. Mornæum in lib. de Verita-
te Relig. Christianæ, pag. 516. & Nicolaum Fulle-
rum in Miscellan. Theol. libro 2. cap. 5.

[Hebrew word] Ch. & Syr. Hic, huc, illuc: [Hebrew word] Idem, & non-
nunquam cum interposito [Hebrew word] Huc,
[Hebrew word] Huc & illuc: Exo. 2.12. & aliter,
[Hebrew words] Itinere diei hinc, & itinere diei
illinc, Num. 11.31. [Hebrew word] Hinc: geminatum in eâdem
sententia, est Hinc, Inde, ut Exod. 17.12. 2. Sam. 2.13.
